import pixeltable as px

# Get reference to the existing videos table
videos = px.get_table('videos')

# Create a view that expands each video into one row per frame at 1 fps
@px.view
def frames_1fps(videos):
    frame_iter = px.FrameIterator(videos.video, fps=1)
    return {
        'frame': frame_iter.image,
        'frame_index': frame_iter.index,
        'frame_timestamp': frame_iter.timestamp,
    }

```python
import pixeltable as px

# Get reference to the existing videos table
videos = px.get_table('videos')

# Create a view that expands each video into one row per frame at 1 fps
@px.view
def frames_1fps(videos):
    frame_iter = px.FrameIterator(videos.video, fps=1)
    return {
        'frame': frame_iter.image,
        'frame_index': frame_iter.index,
        'frame_timestamp': frame_iter.timestamp,
    }

# Access the view
frames_view = px.get_view('frames_1fps')
```
